ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity yellowish-tan pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central high-intensity tan region bifurcated by the median notch, bordered by a dense low-intensity black perimeter. Irregular black pixel streaks and small focal clusters are mapped within the interior tan regions, particularly on the right lobe's medial-distal quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a high-depth bounding box relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by sharp peaks and jagged valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve fitting showing initial concavity moving outward from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of multiple small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) concentrated primarily on the distal tips and near the insertion point at the bottom center.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the right lobe, specifically a cluster of three parallel diagonal lines in the lower-medial section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical erosion and irregular tissue loss along the trailing edge serrations; dark linear scarring on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique feathered transition zone where the black perimeter pigmentation interdigitates with the central tan region in a splash-like pattern.
